spoken_script.narration_text: Every quarter, a fund has to prove it can pay redemptions without selling its best assets at a loss. That proof is a liquidity buffer, cash and near-cash instruments held aside for exactly this moment. This quarter's buffer covers redemptions up to a level the fund has not approached in three years. The real test is not the number itself, it is whether the buffer would still hold if two of the fund's largest holders redeemed on the same day.
